answers.transcript: Raft uses randomized election timers to avoid split votes. When a follower does not hear heartbeats, it transitions to candidate, increments term, votes for itself, and requests votes from peers.
answers.answer_text: Raft uses randomized election timers to avoid split votes. When a follower does not hear heartbeats, it transitions to candidate, increments term, votes for itself, and requests votes from peers.
answers.feedback: Accurately covered term incrementing and peer quorum votes.
